borrowerNotes.vi: VietCredit công bố biểu lãi suất 0–89%/năm cho Tin Vay nhưng không nói mức nào dành cho ai, và các trang quảng cáo của Tin Vay ghi mức khác. Vì vậy chúng tôi tính ở mức cao nhất, 89%/năm, để bạn thấy chi phí cao nhất theo biểu công bố. Điều này không có nghĩa VietCredit sẽ áp dụng 89%/năm cho bạn. Lãi suất của bạn ghi trong hợp đồng; hãy hỏi trước khi ký.
borrowerNotes.en: VietCredit publishes a 0–89% a year rate table for Tin Vay without saying who gets which rate, and Tin Vay's adverts quote other figures. So we calculate at the top, 89% a year, to show the highest cost under that table. This does not mean VietCredit will charge you 89%. Your rate is in your contract; ask before signing.

borrowerNotes.vi: Tin Vay đăng ký qua ứng dụng đối tác, và một số kênh chỉ mời khách hàng trong danh sách chọn sẵn, nên bạn có thể không đăng ký được.
borrowerNotes.en: Tin Vay is applied for through partner apps, and some channels only invite pre-selected customers, so you may not be able to apply.

borrowerNotes.vi: Chỉ tải ứng dụng từ App Store hoặc Google Play, kiểm tra đúng tên nhà phát triển, và đừng chuyển tiền cho ai trước khi nhận khoản vay.
borrowerNotes.en: Download apps only from the App Store or Google Play, check the developer's name, and don't send anyone money before you receive a loan.

products.notes: Scope and source of the company rate table: 'BIỂU LÃI SUẤT CHO SẢN PHẨM VAY TIÊU DÙNG TIN VAY (Dành cho khách hàng cá nhân vay tiêu dùng)', Decision 145C/2026/VietCredit-QĐ, effective 01/02/2026 until amended; it replaces decision 330D/2025/VietCredit-QĐ of 21/05/2025 (issued for the Digital Lending business centre). It covers the Tin Vay individual consumer loan only: not credit cards, BNPL, small-trader or business loans. It does not name channels; that it covers every partner channel is our reading of the 'TIN VAY' contract family, not a statement in the table. Read 2026-11-04 with pdftotext. Contract documents read: T&C (BM 02-CVTD-L6, dated 12.10.2026 on the forms list, also 18.08.2026), credit contract and loan application templates (06.10.2025), payment schedule template. Contract art. 1.7 says VietCredit charges no other interest or fee than those listed in the contract, and no insurance appears in any of these documents; insurance is therefore not in the product, but because the percentage fields are blank the file is marked 'unknown' for insurance.

researchNotes:
Researched 2026-11-04 (retrievedAt on every figure that was re-read that day). Lender: Công ty Tài chính tổng hợp cổ phần Tín Việt (VietCredit), licensed finance company. Consumer lending brand: Tin Vay (tinvay.com.vn, hotline 1900 638 996). Corporate sites: vietcredit.com.vn (company, investors, BNPL, small-trader loan) and vietcredit.vn (credit cards, app, Tin Vay PDF documents).

KEY FINDING, RATES: the only rate document VietCredit publishes for Tin Vay is a company rate table, 'BIỂU LÃI SUẤT CHO SẢN PHẨM VAY TIÊU DÙNG TIN VAY (Dành cho khách hàng cá nhân vay tiêu dùng)', Decision 145C/2026/VietCredit-QĐ, effective 01/02/2026 until amended (https://tinvay.com.vn/BIEUMAU/VAYTIEUDUNGCANHAN/VaytieudungCanhanBieumaulaisuat010220261.pdf). Wording: 'LÃI SUẤT (%/năm/Dư nợ giảm dần)'; 'Lãi suất cho vay trong hạn: Thấp nhất 0%/năm, Cao nhất 89%/năm'; 'Lãi suất quá hạn: 130% lãi suất cho vay trong hạn'; 'Lãi suất cụ thể áp dụng cho các khách hàng theo phê duyệt của Công ty trong từng thời kỳ'. It replaces 330D/2025 (21/05/2025, 0-72%) which replaced 192B/2025 (0-76%) and 777D/2024 (18-72%). It applies to one product line (Tin Vay individual consumer loans), not to the whole company, and it is a framework, so it is stored as regulatory_ceiling with a clear segment. Because no product has an offered range, no VietCredit product is rankable.

THE topi.vn LEAD (9.12-48.31%/year, reducing balance, 365-day basis, from March 2026): not found in any VietCredit page, rate table, contract, T&C, card document or press article read. Searched: all 7 consumer rate tables on tinvay.com.vn/bieu-mau (6 listed, 4 read), T&C 12.10.2026 and 18.08.2026, contract templates 06.10.2025 (two), loan application, payment schedule, GrabPAX and Grab driver/merchant templates, TinCard and TikTok PayLater T&C, the investor pages, and text searches for '9,12', '48,31' and 'khung lãi suất'. The figures do sit inside the lender's own 0-89% frame, so they are not necessarily false, but they are not stated by VietCredit. topi.vn is a Tin Vay distribution partner (its page says 'Lãi suất ưu đãi riêng cho TOPI - chỉ từ 1.7%/tháng'), so it is not a neutral comparison source.

CHANNEL RATES: the Tin Vay channel pages (Viettel Money from 3.5%/month, TOPI from 2.08%/month or 0.06%/day, VNPT Money from 0.1%/day, Zalo Fiza from 1.42%/month promo) are all 'từ' starting rates with no maximum, so they are advertised_floor. Press of 08/04/2026 quotes lower or different floors (Viettel Money 3.2%, TOPI 1.25%, VNPT 5.6%/month, ZaloPay 3.6%/month); these are tier 3 and not stored.

BASIS TESTS: all VietCredit-stated bases are 'dư nợ giảm dần' (rate table, contract template art. 1.7(a), Viettel Money, VNPT, TOPI FAQ), with interest = daily balance x days x annual rate / 365 (T&C art. 3.5; contract art. 1.8). VietCredit publishes no worked example (no sample loan with an instalment) on any page, so the labels could not be tested against an example. Repayment style (equal instalments or equal principal) is not named anywhere: amortization is 'unknown'. Surprise: MoMo's generic 'Vay nhanh' page (several lenders, so not stored as VietCredit data) gives 50,000,000 over 12 months at 2.95%/month, total interest 17,692,000 and 5,661,000 a month; that equals flat arithmetic (50M x 2.95% x 12 = 17.7M, plus 20,000 collection fee a month), not reducing balance, although the page says 'trên dư nợ gốc'. Worth asking MoMo/VietCredit which basis applies on that channel.

LICENCE NUMBER: tinvay.com.vn states 'Giấy phép số 59/GP-NHNN ngày 18/06/2018'; data/licensed-institutions.json has 'Giấy phép số 48/GP-NHNN ngày 06/11/2023' (SBV list). Same company (legal name and tax code 0102766770); probably a re-issued licence. Not a data conflict in this file but worth a check against the SBV list. The legal name on the SBV list is 'Công ty Tài chính tổng hợp cổ phần Tín Việt' (documents print 'Tổng hợp Cổ phần').

FEES AND INSURANCE: the generic contract template (art. 1.7) lists only the in-term rate, overdue-principal rate, interest on late interest (0% in one template, blank in the other) and an early-repayment fee in two bands (before/after the first payment date), percentages left blank, and says VietCredit charges no other interest or fee. The Viettel Money page states 5% x remaining principal; GrabPAX and Grab driver/merchant templates state 5% x principal repaid early. Paying instalments in advance without settling is free (T&C art. 8.1). Collection or transfer fees are charged by third parties per payment and are shown as a column in the payment schedule (amount unknown). T&C art. 17 has an 8% breach penalty that does not apply to late principal or interest. No insurance is mentioned in any Tin Vay document, so insurance lists are empty and marked 'unknown' (the template is silent; we did not see a published statement that no insurance is sold).

LIMITS AND ELIGIBILITY: no age, income or residence rule is published for the generic product. Age rules exist per channel (MoMo 18-50, Viettel Money 18-55, TOPI 18-55, VNPT Money 18-55). Tin Vay needs only a CCCD, no income proof (page), so it will not filter for salaried status. Amounts: generic page 5-50 million; channel tables up to 100 million, and Grab Driver up to 200 million (above the 100M finance-company cap; recorded as a conflict on the generic product).

NOT INCLUDED, WITH REASONS: small-trader instalment loan (vay-tieu-dung-tieu-thuong, 48%/year reducing, up to 100M, 12 months, age 20-60, for business owners, not salaried); Grab Driver loans and the GFIN electric-motorbike instalment loan (Grab driver partners only; rates 12.9-19% by term on declining balance per the 13/08/2026 notice, 0 down payment); Tin Vay Biz and household/business loans; car loan PDF (Tin Go); domestic TinCard (rate table 1452B/2023 effective 02/01/2024 is older than 12 months, fee table is layered and could not be matched row by row); Fundiin, AhaMove, VietinBank iPay and ZaloPay channels (announcements and table rows only, no rates; Fundiin 'tới 80 triệu', VietinBank iPay 'lên đến 100 triệu').

WHERE SEARCHED, STILL UNKNOWN: (1) Per-customer or per-product offered rate range: not published; searched the rate tables, T&C, templates, channel pages, notices (20 on tinvay.com.vn/tin-tuc/thong-bao), app listing page (vietcredit.vn/thong-bao/tai-ung-dung-vietcredit has no figures; Google Play and App Store listing pages could not be opened by URL), investor pages, news (thoibaotaichinhvietnam.vn, vnba.org.vn, VietCredit English news). (2) Early-repayment percentage for the generic product and for MoMo, VNPT, TOPI: left blank in the template, 'see contract' on channel pages. (3) Insurance: no document mentions it. (4) Any worked example: none on lender pages.

DOCUMENT FRESHNESS: the 145C/2026 PDF has file metadata dated 2026-08-19 although the decision is dated 01/02/2026; the forms page also lists T&C dated 12.10.2026 and Grab contract forms dated 04.09.2026 and 12.10.2026, so the forms page is maintained. A newer rate table could exist but none is listed. Treat confidence as medium until VietCredit confirms. UPDATE 2026-11-04: under DECISIONS #61 the general Tin Vay product is ranked, costed at the top of 0-89%. The 2021 fake-app warning isn't shown as a fact because its source couldn't be traced; a general safety note is shown instead.
